# Game Idea: Asteroid Escape

A simple HTML‑canvas arcade game where the player controls a small ship with arrow keys, navigating a field of randomly spawning asteroids that drift across the screen. The ship must avoid any collision; touching an asteroid immediately ends the game. The score increases over time, encouraging longer survival and occasional power‑ups for temporary shields.

1: // Simple asteroid escape game
2: // Assumes an HTML <canvas id="game"></canvas> exists.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Audio setup
12:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
13:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
14:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
15:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
16:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
17:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
18:     osc.type = 'sine';
19:     osc.connect(gain);
20:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     osc.start();
23:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
24:   }
25: 
26:   // Generate background stars
27:   const starCount = Math.floor((width * height) / 8000);
28:   const stars = [];
29:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
30:     stars.push({
31:       x: Math.random() * width,
32:       y: Math.random() * height,
33:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
34:       twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
35:     });
36:   }
37: 
38: 
39: 
40: 
41:   // Input handling
42:   const keys = {};
43:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
44:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
45: 
46:   // Asteroid pool
47:   const asteroids = [];
48:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
49:   const asteroidInterval = 90; // frames between spawns
50: 
51:   // Game state
52:   let score = 0;
53:   let running = true;
54: 
55:   function spawnAsteroid() {
56:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
57:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size * 2) + size;
58:     const y = -size;
59:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
60:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius: size, speed, color: '#888' });
61:   }
62: 
63:   function updateShip() {
64:     ship.dx = 0;
65:     ship.dy = 0;
66:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
67:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.dx = ship.speed;
68:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
69:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = ship.speed;
70:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(width - ship.radius, ship.x + ship.dx));
71:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(height - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.dy));
72:   }
73: 
74:   function updateAsteroids() {
75:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const a = asteroids[i];
77:       a.y += a.speed;
78:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
79:     }
80:     if (asteroidTimer-- <= 0) {
81:       spawnAsteroid();
82:       asteroidTimer = asteroidInterval;
83:     }
84:   }
85: 
86:   function checkCollision() {
87:     for (const a of asteroids) {
88:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
89:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
90:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
91:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
92:         // Play collision sound
93:         if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
94:         playBeep(200, 0.2);
95:         running = false;
96:         break;
97:       }
98:     }
99:   }
100: 
101:   function drawShip() {
102:     // Draw ship as a simple triangle pointing upwards
103:     const size = ship.radius * 2;
104:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y - ship.radius, ship.x, ship.y + ship.radius);
105:     gradient.addColorStop(0, '#66f');
106:     gradient.addColorStop(1, '#004');
107:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
108:     ctx.beginPath();
109:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.radius); // tip
110:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
111:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
112:     ctx.closePath();
113:     ctx.fill();
114:   }
115: 
116:   function drawAsteroids() {
117:     for (const a of asteroids) {
118:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
119:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
120:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
121:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
122:       ctx.beginPath();
123:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
124:       ctx.fill();
125:     }
126:   }
127: 
128:   function drawScore() {
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
130:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
131:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
132:   }
133: 
134:   let frame = 0;
135: 
136: function drawBackground() {
137:   // Space gradient
138:   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
139:   grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
140:   grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
141:   ctx.fillStyle = grad;
142:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
143: }
144: 
145: function drawStars() {
146:   for (const s of stars) {
147:     const alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frame * 0.05 + s.twinkle);
148:     ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
149:     ctx.beginPath();
150:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
151:     ctx.fill();
152:   }
153: }
154: 
155: function loop() {
156:   if (!running) {
157:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
158:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
160:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
161:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
162:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
163:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 30);
164:     return;
165:   }
166:   // Clear and draw background
167:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
168:   drawBackground();
169:   drawStars();
170:   updateShip();
171:   updateAsteroids();
172:   checkCollision();
173:   drawShip();
174:   drawAsteroids();
175:   drawScore();
176:   score += 0.05; // increase over time
177:   frame++;
178:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
179: }
180: 
181:   // Start the game loop
182:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
183: })();
